basic.title: Opening, Wheel, And The First Turn
basic.description: Start at the first real decision: push the shared wheel, read its result, then complete one hand action.

steps.welcome: Three victory conditions: control 16 regions at New Year, capture an opponent's capital, or reach 3 prestige.
steps.turnFlow: The player action flow is: 1. Check the hand limit; 2. Move the wheel; 3. Perform one wheel action and one hand action in either order.
steps.wheelFirst: The opening hand-limit check has resolved automatically. Ming has 3 cards and a 15-card limit, so no discard is required. Enter the wheel action.
steps.wheelRule: The shared wheel can move 1, 2, or 3 spaces. All three moves are legal, and each produces a different wheel resolution.
steps.wheelMove: Click the highlighted Recruit / Train sector on the wheel.
steps.wheelResult: Recruit / Train is resolved: Xuanfu's troop count rises from 1 to 3; 2 new level-2 regular troops are added. Xuanfu has no artillery at this point, so no artillery is trained.
steps.handActionOrder: Each turn allows 1 hand action. Ming's four same-level faction actions are Raid, Recruit, Grant Pardon, and Drive Tiger. The rules set no fixed order among these four actions; the hand action and wheel action also have no fixed order.
steps.grantPardonRule: Grant Pardon: discard 3 hand cards and name 1 opponent. That player chooses a troop adjacent to a Ming-controlled region, moves it into the neighboring Ming-controlled region, and converts it to Ming. In the digital flow, click the receiving region first; if it uniquely identifies one opponent, the system locks that opponent automatically. Only when multiple opponents remain does the acting player choose the remaining opponent.
steps.pickAction: Click the Grant Pardon action on the right.
steps.payCards: Click 3 hand cards in turn. Each clicked card lifts, enlarges, and shows a gold Selected mark; confirm when the payment panel reaches 3 / 3.
steps.chooseGrantPardonTarget: Click the highlighted Shanhaiguan region as the receiving region. If it uniquely identifies one opponent, the system locks that opponent automatically.
steps.chooseGrantPardonSource: Later Jin player: click one highlighted Jinzhou troop. It immediately moves into Shanhaiguan and becomes a Ming troop.
steps.actionResult: Grant Pardon is complete: Jinzhou troops decrease from 2 to 1, Shanhaiguan troops increase from 2 to 3, and the selected troop now belongs to Ming.
steps.finish: This part of the first turn is complete.

attackAndBattle.title: Attack And Field Battle
attackAndBattle.description: Raid starts from a hand action, then flows into field battle, tactics, damage assignment, and retreat handling.

steps.actionOverview: The right side lists Ming's four same-level faction actions: Raid, Recruit, Grant Pardon, and Drive Tiger. Choose 1 each turn.
steps.chooseAction: Now choose Raid. Rule: discard 1 hand card to make an attack; dispatch is not allowed.
steps.payRaid: Now select 1 hand card and confirm payment.
steps.borderWidth: The attack moves from Keshiketeng into Chahar. Read battle width 3.
steps.battleOpen: Entering an enemy region starts a field battle. Reveal both sides, then open the tactic window.
steps.tacticWindow: Click Cavalry Charge, then click Play Tactic Card to confirm.
steps.battleDamage: Now click Rear Guard to resolve the field battle. Resolve artillery, cavalry, then infantry; each 3 points deals 1 damage.
steps.battleResult: The field battle is resolved: Chahar troops decrease from 1 to 0. Then read the surviving troops and the next post-battle action.
steps.retreatAndDefeat: The losing side chooses either Rear Guard or Rout.
steps.postBattleChoice: Now use the post-battle panel to choose the closing action.
steps.finish: Field battle, retreat, and post-battle handling are complete. Return to the map result.

siege.title: Siege And Occupation
siege.description: Siege covers defender city withdrawal, city battle resolution, and the post-victory choice between siege and occupation.

steps.overview: Enter the Shanhaiguan city battle. Resolve the defender choice, city battle, then siege or occupation.
steps.defendCity: Choose Hold City. The defender moves troops and population into the city.
steps.cityBattle: After the defenders enter the city, click Rear Guard. Resolve artillery, then cavalry and infantry; cavalry takes -1 here.
steps.cityResult: The city battle is resolved. Read the siege / occupation entry in the post-battle panel.
steps.besiegeChoice: Choose Besiege, then confirm Besiege This Region.
steps.occupyChoice: Siege keeps defender control and the siege state; occupation changes control to Ming and clears the city garrison.
steps.finish: The city battle is complete; siege or occupation decides Shanhaiguan control and city state.

retreatAndRout.title: Retreat And Rout
retreatAndRout.description: The field-battle loser chooses between rear guard and rout.

steps.overview: Enter the losing side's retreat choice: Rear Guard or Rout.
steps.routResult: After routing, the top player information gains 1 defeat marker, and the source region no longer keeps the routed force.
steps.finish: The map shows troop results; the top player information shows defeat markers.

cavalryPlunder.title: Cavalry Plunder
cavalryPlunder.description: Cavalry can switch to plunder: take artillery/cavalry counterfire first, then plunder population with surviving cavalry and retreat.

steps.overview: Enter the cavalry plunder choice. Resolve counterfire, then population, cards, and retreat.
steps.plunderResult: Plunder is complete: target population is lower, cavalry retreats, and the deck changes are synced.

cavalryEvasion.title: Cavalry Evasion
cavalryEvasion.description: Defending cavalry can leave a field battle for an adjacent friendly region without being treated as routed.

steps.overview: Enter the defending cavalry evasion choice.
steps.chooseEvasion: Click the highlighted adjacent friendly region to move the defending cavalry.
steps.evasionResult: The defending cavalry has left the original battle; the original battle continues.
steps.finish: Evasion changes troop position without a defeat-retreat penalty.

neutralInvasion.title: Neutral Invasion
neutralInvasion.description: When you attack an unoccupied neutral region with population, neutral defenders are generated for the battle.

steps.overview: Enter neutral-region battle resolution. An unoccupied neutral region with population generates neutral defenders.
steps.resolveNeutral: Now click battle resolution. Neutral defenders are created from Tumed's population.
steps.neutralResult: Neutral defenders now occupy Tumed; the attacker did not defeat them, so control stays neutral.
steps.finish: Neutral control changes only if the attack breaks through.

waterDispatch.title: Water Dispatch
waterDispatch.description: Ming can dispatch through anchor-region sea routes; cavalry dispatch can reach farther, but each sea route still commits at most 2 troops.

steps.overview: Enter water dispatch. Ming moves troops through sea routes between anchor regions.
steps.chooseWaterTarget: Click Dongjiang as the water destination. Each sea route commits at most 2 troops, and the route cannot switch back to land.
steps.waterBoundary: The water boundary has battle width 2, so at most 2 troops fight there.
steps.finish: Water changes route and battle width; the normal battle rules still resolve.

wheelSharedCost.title: Wheel Branches And Development Actions
wheelSharedCost.description: Longer shared-wheel movement refills opponents and lands the turn in attack, dispatch, diplomacy, or hiring systems.

steps.overview: Enter the 3-space wheel branch. Both opponents draw 2, and the turn lands on attack / dispatch.
steps.chooseMove: Click the highlighted Attack / Dispatch sector on the wheel.
steps.drawResult: After the wheel moves 3 spaces, read the Mongol and Later Jin hands: each gains 2 cards.
steps.dispatchReady: The wheel lands on attack / dispatch. Discard 1 card, move up to 6 troops, and battle only in an enemy or non-friendly region.
steps.finish: Wheel resolution is complete; the next entry is attack / dispatch.

wheelReclaim.title: Wheel Reclaim
wheelReclaim.description: Wheel Reclaim directly adds population to a controlled region.

steps.chooseMove: Click the highlighted Reclaim sector on the wheel.
steps.result: Reclaim is complete: Xuanfu population increases by 1.

wheelMilitaryFarm.title: Wheel Military Farm
wheelMilitaryFarm.description: Wheel Military Farm adds both cards and troops.

steps.chooseMove: Click the highlighted Military Farm sector on the wheel.
steps.result: Military Farm is complete: 1 level-2 regular troop appears in Xuanfu, and the hand is replenished.

wheelRecruitTrain.title: Wheel Recruit And Train
wheelRecruitTrain.description: Wheel Recruit / Train adds troops and trains artillery by armament level.

steps.chooseMove: Click the highlighted Recruit / Train sector on the wheel.
steps.result: Recruit / Train is complete: Xuanfu's total troop count rises from 2 to 4; 2 new level-2 regular troops are added, and the existing level-1 artillery is trained to level 2.

armamentUpgrade.title: Armament Upgrade
armamentUpgrade.description: Armament upgrade spends hand cards and updates the armament level on the live board.

steps.actionOverview: Armament Upgrade: play an armament card, discard 1 hand card, and upgrade that armament.
steps.chooseAction: Now click Artillery Technology in hand.
steps.payCards: Play Artillery Technology, discard 1 hand card, and confirm.
steps.result: Artillery Technology rises from level 1 to level 2.
steps.finish: Armament Upgrade is complete; later battles use level-2 Artillery Technology.

eventAction.title: Khan's Edict
eventAction.description: Khan's Edict is the Mongol faction action. It resolves through payment, effect choice, and result, with the discard and map change landing together.

steps.overview: Now enter the Mongol hand action.
steps.actionOverview: The right side lists three same-level Mongol faction actions: Raid, Horse Market, and Khan's Edict. Choose 1 each turn.
steps.chooseAction: Now click Khan's Edict. Discard 1 hand card, then perform Recruit / Train or Diplomatic Hiring without another payment.
steps.chooseEffect: Choose the target region, then choose Recruit / Train to resolve the effect.
steps.result: Khan's Edict is complete: Mongol troops in Shanhaiguan rise from 2 to 4.

diplomacy.title: Diplomacy And Hire
diplomacy.description: Enter a real wheel diplomacy step and see control markers and hired troops resolve together.

steps.wheelEntry: Click the highlighted Diplomacy / Hire sector on the wheel.
steps.chooseTarget: The target must border a controlled region; homeland, Korea, and regions with regular troops are excluded.
steps.friendlyMark: Click Ningyuan to place a friendly marker. Troops may pass and station there, but it is not a controlled region.
steps.tributeMark: Flip the friendly marker to a vassal marker. A face-up marker counts as your controlled region.
steps.removeMark: Click Dongjiang and remove the rival control marker.
steps.finish: Diplomacy markers and hired troops are resolved.

yearAndCharacters.title: Midyear, New Year, And Chronology
yearAndCharacters.description: Midyear taxes, character checks, New Year maintenance, attrition, chronology scoring, and turn-order refresh form the yearly resolution.

steps.overview: Enter Midyear and New Year resolution: taxes, characters, fortifications, attrition, chronology, and turn order.
steps.advanceMidyear: Click the highlighted Midyear position at the bottom of the wheel.
steps.midyearTax: Midyear taxes are complete: read resources in the top player information; besieged regions do not collect tax.
steps.midyearCharacters: Character checks are complete: read characters and defeat markers in the top player information.
steps.advanceNewYear: After Midyear resolves, click the highlighted New Year position at the top of the wheel.
steps.newYearTribute: New Year tribute: the controller of each Korea region draws its marked Korea cards.
steps.newYearMaintenance: Then click "Auto pay" to handle fortification maintenance. If the Great Wall, Shanhaiguan, Ningyuan, or Jinzhou cannot be maintained, they fall into ruin and their border and city effects fail.
steps.newYearAttrition: Maintenance is complete: read attrition results on the map and in the top player information.
steps.chronologyScore: Chronology resolves: the highest score pays half the hand for the year's prestige, or passes.
steps.turnOrderRefresh: Chronology is complete: the year card, current actor, and character states refresh.

koreaSpecial.title: Korea And Special Map Rules
koreaSpecial.description: Korea, Hanseong, sea routes, and Shanhaiguan are map-specific rules that directly change play.

steps.overview: Enter the Korea, Hanseong, waterway, and Shanhaiguan special rules.
steps.koreaRegion: Tribute icons set the New Year draw; control decides who receives it.
steps.hanseongVp: Hanseong control is worth 1 prestige; read it in the top player information.
steps.waterLimit: Anchor water routes move at most 2 troops; cavalry cannot evade through water.
steps.newYearMaintenance: Click Auto Pay to enter New Year maintenance.
steps.koreaAttrition: Korea provides no population support; read Korean troop attrition after maintenance.
steps.shanhaiguan: Shanhaiguan is a city and a special border; intact is narrow, ruined is wider.
steps.finish: The Korea, Hanseong, waterway, and Shanhaiguan special rules are complete.

selectedRegion.title: Selected region details
selectedRegion.purposeDiagnostic: Only used for sample guidance, magic-wand work, and chain boundary repair; it is excluded automatically from formal mask/graph exports.
selectedRegion.purposeFormal: The mask handles clicking and highlighting; the passage graph only expresses rules-level connectivity.
selectedRegion.truthDiagnostic: Diagnostic sample. It can validate direction but cannot replace formal region truth.
selectedRegion.truthAuthoritative: Explicit truth. The main pipeline consumes this region result directly.
selectedRegion.truthBootstrap: Heuristic bootstrap. It still needs chain refinement or promotion into explicit truth.
selectedRegion.sharedPrintedRuntime: This printed region currently maps to runtime regions: {{names}}.
selectedRegion.runtimeOnlyGuideBlocker: The blocker is not missing drawing work. The current guide target is still bound to `regionIds`, so runtime-only gaps like {{names}} cannot yet be written straight into the workspace authoritative guide file.
